_comment: Counts the gate-4 run must reproduce over today's fgp_transcriptions.db (45,034 rows), gate2.db (with the fist_comment_no_publish hold), gate3.db (with the 10 approvals of 2026-10-26), inventory.db and nli_crossref.db, with the plain new-rows policy, the test_or_dummy, legacy_font, stub_retired (by containment), personal_data and superseded_version (FIST RecordStatus 5) and status1_translation rules and the listed exclusions (scripts/fgp_gate4_exclusions.json, rulings of 2026-10-26 evening), the Word-file rules of 2026-10-26 (docx_multicolumn_table and pdf_held hold; hidden runs, numbering, footnotes, tracked changes and one-column tables render), no gate-4 approvals and the declared reference set (docs/plans/FGP_CHOOSER_VALIDATION_RULES.md).
